entities.name: Query protein (194 aa)
observations: Sequence length is 194 aa; estimated molecular mass is 22.1 kDa.
Sequence has a Ham1p_like Pfam domain (PF01725.22) spanning residues 3–186, i-Evalue 2.4e-62.
Homologs A6LGA4, Q8A327, and B5YHP2 show 44.7–46.6% identity over approximately 96% of the sequence.
Likely belongs to the bacterial dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase family; exact substrate preference remains homology-based rather than directly demonstrated for this sequence.

entities.name: A6LGA4
observations: Reviewed UniProt homolog from Parabacteroides distasonis annotated as a dITP/XTP pyrophosphatase.
Catalyzes hydrolysis of noncanonical purine nucleoside triphosphates, especially XTP, dITP, and ITP, to monophosphate products.
Annotated as a homodimer and cytosolic protein.
Homology to query: 46.6% identity, 96.9% query coverage, E-value 1.61e-54.

entities.name: Q8A327
